title: Request a Peer Support Group or Volunteer Training
closedMessage: Requests for a peer support group, a volunteer training or a collaboration are on Google Forms for now. Questions: hello@badgersupports.org.
intro: Badger Supports offers peer-led trainings and support spaces that can be requested by student organizations, campus units, or individual students.
Use this form to request a Volunteer Training, a Peer Support Group, or to explore a collaboration with our team.
We'll review your request and someone from our team will reach out to you!
review: Built closed (decision 3.1), from Google's public view of 23 Oct 2026; Request a Program and the workshop page still link the Google Form. Words are Google's; the pin emoji before 'Questions?' is left out. Google's form is one page with no section titles; both titles are ours. Google's closing block sits above Submit; here it is the confirmation. Four questions say '(if applicable)', '(if known)' or ask 'Any…?' yet are required in Google's form; they are kept required, each with a note, until Programs says otherwise. The closing message is ours.
